name: Dìrlàrach
text: A steel landing block set beside an elevator shaft. Use it to call the cabin to this floor, or to send the cabin onward when it is already here.

name: Stiùrdhìrich
text: The motor housing above the shaft. It finds every floor block beside the shaft below it and drives the cabin between them. It can optionally draw Forge Energy.

name: Bothanlàr
text: The deck plate of the cabin. It rides the shaft and carries players, mobs and items. Use it to choose the next floor, or sneak to go the other way.

name: Lumvarrek
text: Light bridge emitter. With a redstone signal it lays a walkable strip of light 24 blocks long in front of it, stopping at the first solid block; with no signal the strip fades. Use it for a drawbridge or a gap in a base. Age V.
